text: {"name":"wlc_print_msg","confidence":"medium","docstring":"If the message passes the rate check, updates the shared logging context, dispatches its worker with a derived time value, and marks the input record with flag 0x200.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v4":"log_context"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Input record flags; bit 9 is set after dispatch."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Context counter decremented when nonzero."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Stores the input record pointer."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Context byte set to 1."},{"offset":29,"meaning":"Context byte set to 4."}]}
